Definition: probably from ἄγνυμι (to break; compare G4486); an axe:--axe.
BiblicalUsage: The axe is already laid to the root of the trees — John the Baptist's warning in both Gospels. Every tree that does not bring forth good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe John's axe is still laid at the root: God looks for fruit, not leaves, and the time to bear it is now.
